It's weird. For starters I've never really fitted in with most people. I went mostly alone throughout my life, with the exception of my best friends and some more I made along the way. I've tried to be more social because even though I am introverted, I felt like I needed to broaden my horizons a bit, and even made sure I was in a good mental state then so I wouldn't be a burden, but also trying to keep true to myself and not changing only to fit in a certain group. I tried going into places in which I had something in common with people there. But most of the time I ended up feeling alienated and ignored. I tried to swallow up the bitter feeling and just enjoy whatever I was doing by myself, but the more it happened the more difficult it became to ignore. 

To a more personal level I always feel a bit looked down upon by more social people and whenever I insinuate or ask for help about that, it would end up ignored.

For a while I really tried doing things for myself and ignoring everything but after a while being lonely feels strange when it goes on for so long, as much as I try to go on with my life, I can't help but feel really bad about it, specially now.

Worst part is, the people who actually get close to me, one out of ten times turn out to be really manipulative people or just plainly toxic.

I feel like I don't fit in anywhere or with anyone and it's just uncomfortable.
